name: factoidal-xmpp-tests
description: Test-only dependencies for the Factoidal XMPP server tests. Kept out of npm/factoidal so nothing here reaches the published @factoidal/core package. @xmpp/client is here to be an XMPP implementation this repository did not write: tools/xmpp-interop.sh drives the Lean server with it over a real socket through the socat carrier.
